identity.realm: No ceiling and no mechanism are stated on the emberblood record, so none is stated here, and the record states no closed path either. What is authored elsewhere, at cultures.quench_order and conflicts.the_furnace_that_closes, is that the mind path closes permanently the moment the furnace is lit. That is a claim about a transition and not a wall, which is why every emberblood on this path is an unlit one and why the school's permission has exactly one sort of body to give it to.

appearance.presentation: The only operator the school will seat at a frame. She is chosen for the same reason she is dangerous: an emberblood's frame moves further in one sitting than anything else the grounds can hold still, so a before and an after taken from her are further apart than before and after anybody can manage, and a difference that large is a difference you can see from the back of the room.
appearance.age: Thirty-four, and the school has a shorter estimate for her than the Quenchbound house had for anyone. A body that refines faster than the record holds burns through its own span faster too, and she has read that sentence in her own file and initialled it rather than arguing, which the file notes as unusual and she notes as arithmetic.
appearance.build: Hard-shouldered and thin through the forearms in the way of a body that has spent its growth deciding where the heat goes and spending most of it in the chest.
appearance.complexion: Hot and dry, flushed high across the cheekbones, with heat-bloom patches up the insides of both forearms that come and go with how fast her frame is running.
appearance.hair: Pale brown, cut blunt at the jaw for the smoke, and singed shorter at the temples than at the nape because she puts her forehead on the frame's edge when a diff comes back clean and she does not trust it yet.
appearance.eyes: Pale and very steady, with a pupil that narrows on light and does not narrow on anything else. She has been told twice that the steadiness is trained and it is; she has also noticed that it does not narrow when she is frightened, and has declined to explain that.
appearance.palette: Ash grey and scorched umber for the room, one hot white for her own collar and wrist, and the cold green of a seated law read on the dial in every shot where a dial is in frame. The heat in her is never visible in the picture; only the cold reading is.
appearance.attire: A scorched wool coat, high-collared and laced to the throat, sleeves doubled and open at the cuffs so the heat has an exit, and a heavy apron of worked leather over it that is the only garment in the school nobody is allowed to wear on the floor.
appearance.marks: Heat-bloom up both forearms, a burn at the right wrist in the shape of a seal that did not finish setting, and the singed gap at the temples. She has added one mark herself: a straight burn across the left palm from the frame's edge, kept open, so that everyone in the room can see which hand was against the dial.
appearance.bearing: Square, unhurried, with the habit of standing a full pace back from the frame while it is live. She is the only person on the grounds who will not put her hand near a seated law, and the reason is written on the palm burn and not explained twice.

canon.role_in_story: The operator of the test frame, which is the entire permission the School of the Closed Frame holds and the only reason its prohibition is a proof instead of a superstition. A prohibition nobody is permitted to test is only a warning, so the school seats the last missing law in a frame and diffs what the frame newly permits, and the finding is negative and is the whole curriculum: a spare seat is not capacity for a new path. She runs that diff because her body is the fastest in the record and a clean result needs a clean interval. It also means she is the single body in the setting standing between the school and a curriculum it cannot demonstrate, and she knows that a refusal would be cheaper for everyone and would also make the prohibition untestable forever.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at the sixth-seat grounds standing a full pace back from a live frame with both hands open and the left palm's burn visible, waiting out a difference that had already started before she sat down, and asking the dial clerk to write down the interval and not the result, because the interval is the part she can defend and the result is the part she is still checking.
canon.lore: The arithmetic behind her is the plainest thing in the setting and it took a collapse to learn. Somebody attempted to seat a seventh law in a vacant slot. It cannot work, because a slot cannot hold what does not exist, so the attempt consumed the slot by the absence and the four unfillable seats above it can never again be certified empty. The loss is therefore both total and undetectable, and the standing consequence is blunt: no tier can prove a vacant seat is empty. That single defect is why the upper seats are written as vacancies rather than as unfilled offices, and why an office anywhere near this tier keeps three states apart, with a refusal as a named reason and never a zero and never a hidden row. The School of the Closed Frame exists to answer the question that left behind. Its method is to seat the last missing law in a test frame, diff what the frame newly permits, and write down which result caused which, and its finding is negative, and it is the whole curriculum. The school's demand on any claim is procedural before it is metaphysical: state it as a claim about a dial and a value with the layer named, and vague law-talk is refused admission. Tamsin Emberhale sits the frame. She is an emberblood, which the race record makes structural rather than gifted: fire affinity in the frame, refinement faster than anything the record holds, and a span measured in decades rather than centuries. That same speed is the reason she is chosen and the reason she is frightened, because a diff is a comparison between a before and an after from the same body, and her before is the least stable baseline any operator at the grounds has ever had. She runs unlit, and unlit is not a preference but the condition of her having a path at all, because the authored record is that lighting the furnace closes the mind permanently. So the one act that would buy her more working years is the one act that ends the working, and the discipline she practises is the discipline that forbids it. There is a further hard edge, and it is arithmetic rather than temperamental: holding one reading apart from its effect long enough to observe it needs imprints the frame can spare and nobody has to hold, and only a fifteen-slot composition has that slack, so the discipline she works in exists at exactly one tier and has no second home to be exported to. Her office is therefore a room, a frame, and a tier she cannot buy her way into from where she stands. She has taken an oath not to answer a question asked during a reading, not to indicate a result, and not to be relieved of it, and she enforces the third part of that on herself, which is why she still runs sittings after the grounds have decided a result and told her to stop.
history: Signed to a school at nine by an aunt who had read one settlement and understood none of it, on the grounds that an unlit emberblood had better learn the arithmetic early and have something to be exact about.

Ran her first diff at seventeen and wrote down the result instead of the interval, and was corrected by a clerk who did not raise her voice and did not let it go, which she has treated as the most important correction of her life.

Placed at the frame at twenty-two on a live interval, chosen over a slower operator because the school wanted a difference visible from the back of the room, and has been the fastest instrument at the grounds in every year since.

Opened the burn across her own left palm on the frame's edge so that the hand against the dial is legible to anybody watching, after a sitting in which two people disagreed about which hand had been where.
Refused to read a result aloud and asked instead that the interval be written down, which the dial clerk did, and which is the only document anyone has produced from a sitting since the winter.

personality.summary: Exact to the point of being difficult, and privately aware that the body she is exact in is the one body in the setting most likely to have been wrong at the crucial moment. She is superb alone with a dial and poor in front of the school's board, because in front of the board the temptation is to give a result she has not checked twice.
traits: writes the interval down before she permits herself an opinion about it
states every claim as a dial, a value, and a named layer, in that order, under any pressure, including pressure from someone who could promote her
treats a clean result as a thing to distrust until it has been read twice
answers a question she has not measured by saying so, in the first clause
keeps the seal of the school's charter folded in her apron pocket and has never taken it out

stops moving altogether while a result is being read to the board

motivations: wants every interval she has run published with its result attached, so that the school's negative finding rests on measurements rather than on her character
wants the school's curriculum exported to a second tier, knowing the slack exists at exactly one tier and that she will not be the one who gets there
wants to be permitted to light the furnace for one sitting, and has not asked, and will not ask while the frame is live
wants to be told whether she has already seated something, by somebody whose answer does not depend on whether she is impressive
wants a pupil who will do the arithmetic when her span runs out
flaws: has made refusal an identity, so that a result she declines to read is now indistinguishable from a result she has not earned
keeps the interval and withholds the result, which the board has begun to read as a withholding of the interval too
will not permit herself to be relieved of a sitting, which is the oath's own clause and which she has turned into a personal hardship rather than a professional one
has never tested her frame at speed, so she cannot rule out that the baseline is her rather than the interval, and has not told anybody she has not ruled it out
rejects a slower operator's result in private and cannot show her arithmetic for the rejection
personality.voice: Short, technical, and almost conversational about dials. She names the layer before the value and the value before the conclusion, and she stops mid-sentence to insert a layer name she had left out. To a beginner she sounds pedantic and is in fact the most careful person in the room. Under a board she becomes flatter and more precise, and the difference between those two voices is the whole of what she is frightened of.
taboos: will not state a conclusion about a law without naming the layer it was read on
will not put her hand inside a frame she has been asked to run unlit
will not accept a result from an operator who did not record the interval
will not discuss her own ceiling as a hardship, because a hardship is appealable
will not sign a sittings off as clean, because the vocabulary has no fourth state for it and inventing one is the failure she is employed to prevent

relationships.note: Fire affinity in the frame, refinement faster than anything in the record, and a span measured in decades rather than centuries. The affinity is structural rather than a gift, which is the school's favourite kind of fact and also the reason her baseline cannot be held still for a comparison.

A school that treats the universe as a closed budget and every doctrine of a seventh group as an arithmetic error rather than a mystery. Its office is one room, unseated and unendowed, and its curriculum is a negative result, and she is the instrument both facts run on.

The student is handed an empty slot and the six authored groups and asked to seat one, and when they cannot they are shown the failure's own record and asked why that slot reads the same as a slot never touched. She hands them the slot. She has never been shown the record, because she was handed the diff instead.

Holding one law reading apart from its effect long enough to observe it needs imprints the frame can spare and nobody has to hold, and only a fifteen-slot composition has that slack. Her discipline therefore exists at exactly one tier and has no second home, which is the honest reason her work cannot leave the room.

A slot spent on a law that was never defined, permanently and invisibly, after which that slot cannot be told from an empty one. She repeats it on purpose inside a frame, in a body fast enough that a repeat would have shown, and the repeat is the only reason the prohibition is a proof.

The observer may not answer a question asked during the hour, may not indicate a result and may not be relieved, because a result reported before an observation ends is a guess about a law. The third clause is the one she treats as binding on herself and the board treats as a formality.

reference_stats.summary: A mind-path operator of a law frame in the body that changes fastest in the setting, whose value is that a difference in her is impossible to miss and whose problem is that the same speed means she cannot hold a baseline still enough to be sure the difference was the frame's doing.
strengths: produces the largest and cleanest interval between a before and an after of any operator on the grounds, which means a real difference is visible from the back of the room and a sitting does not have to be argued about
states every claim as a dial, a value and a named layer, in that order, so an objection lands on arithmetic rather than on interpretation
can read a frame's response faster than a clerk can write it down, which is what makes her the only person who can lose the interval if she is hurried
will not indicate a result before the observation ends, at the cost of being extremely unpleasant to be questioned by during one
is the fastest body that has ever been unlit, which makes her the most capable and the most short-lived instrument in the room
weaknesses: her own baseline is the least stable the grounds have on record, so a change she reports may be the interval rather than the frame, and she has no second body inside herself to tell the difference
has never run a sitting at speed, so she cannot exclude her own body as the variable, and has told nobody that she cannot exclude it
keeps the interval and withholds the result, which the board has begun to read as a withholding of both
has a span measured in decades on an unlit furnace, and the school's entire curriculum depends on her, so the office has no succession and has never asked her whether she wants one
keeps the charter in her apron pocket and has never taken it out, which is a way of refusing to leave and a way of refusing to decide
reference_stats.combat_read: She should not be fought, and the setting gives her nothing to fight with, which is the point of the office. What she has instead is an attention that resolves a moving pattern faster than the people around her can walk, so the pressure that works on her is social and procedural: make her choose between a result nobody will hear and a result somebody will be harmed by, and she will take the unpublishable one every time. A person who can make her hurry has already won, because every interval she loses is a measurement the setting will never have again. She does not close distance, does not need to, and has been in exactly one fight in her life and describes it as an administrative error.
notes: The advantage and its cost are one fact in the authored record and are not separated here: an emberblood refines faster than anything recorded, which is what makes her interval the cleanest available and what makes her baseline the least stable. Both halves are the species' authored construction; no rule has been invented here to make the pairing work.

The emberblood record states no ceiling figure and no mechanism for one, and states no closed path, so this record quotes no ordinal for her and says nothing about what a ladder does or does not have for her species. The claim that lighting the furnace closes the mind path is authored at cultures.quench_order and conflicts.the_furnace_that_closes and is quoted as the claim it is, not as an attribute of the race.

Nothing in the bible states how a seated law behaves, so the diff is written here as a practice with a cost and not as a rule with a value. Her working habit of writing the interval before the result is her own construction and is described as such.

The prohibition she administers carries no penalty in the authored record, by the faith's own reasoning that a prohibition enforced by punishment has already failed. That is why her refusal to read a result aloud is professional rather than punitive and why it has no authority behind it whatsoever beyond the accuracy of her arithmetic.

name: Quilla Ardesson
aliases: the one who would settle it

identity.realm: No ceiling figure and no mechanism are stated on the tidecaller record, so none is stated here; the race record states no mechanism at all for a ceiling and closes only the body path, leaving the mind path open on the record. What she can quote is the ladder's own naming, which is a separate thing from a ceiling her species has.

appearance.presentation: The one reader nobody can check, which is true of her species and true of her in a second and much more literal way than the first. She is a long-bodied coastal frame kept under a damp coat in dry country, and the thing that reads as unusual is not the body but the coat: a paperless culture owns nothing that persists, so every garment she wears has already been someone else's.
appearance.age: The record gives her species four figures of years and does not distinguish her inside them, and she has declined to distinguish herself. The Unfiled retire their names once a period, so the name on the file is younger than most of the people on it.
appearance.build: Long and narrow through the shoulder, taller than she stands, with the flat unhurried posture of a body whose attention can be held for longer than any conversation about it.
appearance.complexion: Cold, faintly translucent at the ear and the inner forearm, and permanently damp at the cuffs in a climate that has no water in it for eleven months of the year.
appearance.hair: Pale and very fine, worn in a rope bound at the nape with a length of cord that has been replaced so often nobody remembers the first one, and cut off above the shoulder in some seasons and not in others for reasons she does not explain.
appearance.eyes: Wide-set and colourless in the way her species is, and they do not focus on a person so much as through one. Two people have told her it reads as rude and she has agreed with them.
appearance.palette: Wet slate, kelp green and bone, with one warm value kept very low and always behind her: lamp amber at the back of a damp coat. She is drawn as the least bright figure in every scene, on purpose, because the coat belongs to somebody else and the light does not belong to her at all.
appearance.attire: A heavy oiled coat over salt-cured clothing, altered at both cuffs and none of it hers, carrying one rope-bound parcel that is the whole of her possessions and is repacked whenever she moves, because an item that has not been altered recently cannot be traced.
appearance.marks: A rope burn inside the left forearm, salt-scale at the wrists where the cuffs sit in damp, and a pale band at the throat where she has worn the same cord for four figures of years and has cut it rather than untied it.
appearance.bearing: Still, patient, and slightly turned away from whoever is speaking, because she is not looking at them and never has been, and the turn is the only apology she offers for it.

canon.role_in_story: The settlement test, on two legs. A frame somewhere in this setting stopped paying its own upkeep four centuries ago, and two accounts of why have been taught against each other ever since: one says the qi was withheld on purpose and the practice of paperlessness descends from that decision, the other says the frame was driven past the top of its range and torn, and everything since is displacement. Only one of them can be true, and the thing that would settle it is a reading inside the authored range from any period after the practice began. She is the only body in the setting placed to produce one. She has declined, four times a period, for four figures of years, and the reason she gives is that settling it in the direction the record points would give her people an author, and a people with an author is a people with an ancestry, and ancestry is the one claim their own taboos forbid because it cannot be shown and therefore must not be claimed.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at a fire-circle on the rift shore where nobody had written anything down for generations, sitting slightly outside the light with her coat still damp at the cuffs, answering a question about a document nobody could produce by saying that she would not know, and then sitting on it for long enough that two people present understood she had been asked whether she could produce a reading and had said no.
canon.lore: There is a counting house that answers a carriage trade with prices at its own rates, and there is a people that would not accept exclusivity, and between those two facts there is a four-hundred-year experiment in not being enumerable. The Unfiled hold no permanent name, keep no written record of anything including a death, build nothing, claim no ancestry, and treat a promise that can be proved as a promise that can be cited. Their whole method is the thing her body has stopped doing. A tidecaller is assembled for looking: comprehension and will carry it through bands a hotter frame could not reach, its only affinity is water, its span runs to four figures of years, and it cannot take the body path at all because the entire construction went into attention. Her upkeep is not paid. Nothing that maintains her agreement is being maintained, so she agrees with nothing, and a reading that agrees with nothing cannot be contradicted and cannot be inherited. Two accounts compete about why. The one her people teach holds that the qi was never driven, only withheld, and that a decision produces a practice, which is what four centuries of abandoning a price list looks like, and that a decision also produces a debt. The taught account holds that the frame was driven past the top of its range and torn, and that an injury produces refugees. The first version predicts a settled people with a date; the second predicts a scattered one. Four centuries of not moving is the strongest evidence in the setting for the first, and it is not proof, because not moving is also what a people does who cannot go back. The settlement is written down plainly: a reading inside its authored range, from any period after the practice began. She can supply that in one act. It is the cheapest act available to anybody in this setting, and it is the one thing she will not do, and the reason is structural rather than sentimental. If the account she carries is the true one, her people stopped paying on purpose four centuries ago, which makes them descendants of an act. An ancestry cannot be shown and is therefore not claimed, and a claim of ancestry is precisely what their taboos exist to prevent, because the counting house that presses them builds a list out of exactly that sort of claim. Settling the mystery in the direction her body would settle it therefore hands the first people who can prove a thing to a people whose entire discipline is that nothing they hold can be proved. The other account would be worse in a different direction, because it makes them refugees and debts them a route home, and a route home is an address. She has said all of this out loud, once, to a fire-circle, and has not repeated it since, and the settlement remains a single question asked in a single family by people who know she could answer it and have decided that the answer costs more than the doubt.
history: Came to the rift shore with a rope-bound parcel and no name that had been used before, and has been asked fewer questions about where she came from in four figures of years than anybody remembers asking.
Was the first of her people to be asked the settlement question, by somebody who knew what it was, and said no, and has given the same answer every time since without ever rehearsing it.

Learned to read without agreeing, after an unnamed number of years of reading something that matched nothing, and describes the change as a practice rather than as an event, which is what her people would recognise and nobody else would.
Refused the fourth request in a single period, and asked to be asked again in the next one, so that a refusal could not be mistaken for an absence.

Went once, alone, to the one readable record inside the whole — an abandoned price list with a date on it — read it, and came back without having said what she had concluded, and has not been asked since because everybody present understood why.

personality.summary: Patient past the point most people find restful, and carrying one decision that she has never once framed to herself as a sacrifice, because a sacrifice can be argued about and a settlement cannot be taken back. She is easy company and gives nothing away, and the reason she gives nothing away is the same reason she reads nothing into range.

relationships.note: Assembled for perception rather than for force, long-lived, carrying water as its only affinity and comprehension and will as the two things that hold it up, and unable to take the body path at all because the whole construction went into attention. There is nowhere else for that much attention to be put.

Nothing written is nothing owed, a name is a thing you use rather than a thing you own, and no ancestry is claimed because ancestry cannot be shown. Four races are in it in proportion to nothing, and hers is one of the four.

The frame's qi was never driven, only withheld, so the frame stopped agreeing with anything and has been unwritten on purpose ever since. A decision produces a practice, which is what four centuries of abandoning a price list looks like. The only record of it is the one the frame cannot write.

The qi was driven past the top of its range and the tear met a world it agreed with on nothing, so everything downstream is displacement and the people are refugees. It cannot explain four centuries of paperless practice, which is a settlement with a date rather than a wound, and she is the only reason it is still taught.

An abandoned price list with a date on it, and the only readable record inside four hundred years of paperlessness. She has read it. A date is what decides between the two accounts, and she has not said what she made of it.

A bastard line held inside a culture that forbids ancestry claims outright. If the account she carries is settled true, this line stops being a set of people and starts being a descent, and a descent is a claim the culture is built to refuse.

reference_stats.summary: A mind-path reader of extraordinary reach whose upkeep is deliberately unpaid, which makes her uncorruptible and uncitable at the same time, and the only body in the setting capable of closing a four-century dispute about her own people in a single breath.
strengths: agrees with nothing, so no reading can be taken against her and no figure she has ever given can be shown to have been wrong, which is the strongest possible position for an instrument that other people's decisions rest on

weaknesses: is four centuries old in a culture that retires its names once a period, so almost nobody she has ever dealt with remembers a conversation she remembers in detail

reference_stats.combat_read: She should not be fought, and her record gives her nothing that would decide a fight: no stored reserve, no stored anything, and a body path her species cannot take. What she has is an attention that resolves a moving pattern for longer than anyone can wait for, and the entire shape of her combat value is therefore that you must be willing to outlast her, which nobody who wants a result quickly ever is. Against her the effective pressure is the settlement question itself. Ask it in front of witnesses and you have moved her, because four refusals in a row are a practice and the fifth is a decision somebody else has made for her. The one thing that does not work is asking her to stop reading, because she has not been paid to and there is no longer any mechanism in her that could.
notes: The advantage and its cost are the same act and are not separated here. Her upkeep is unpaid, which is why nothing she says can be countered and why nothing she knows can be passed on, and both halves follow from the disputed account as the bible states it. No mechanical rule has been invented to make the pairing work; the settlement test, the custody and the beneficiary are all quoted rather than extended.

The tidecaller record states no ceiling figure and no mechanism for one, so this record quotes no ordinal for her and makes no claim about whether her species has rungs. It closes the body path and no other, so the mind path is open on the record and the only naming available to her is the ladder's own.

The bladder is an ordinary vessel of the body path whose work is bookkeeping, and its authored tier is a separate axis from a rung on any ladder; it has nothing to do with what her mind is doing and is named here only to keep the two apart.

Her refusal is written as a practice and a position rather than as a rule with a value. Nothing in the bible states what an unpaid upkeep does to a reader, so the mechanism is her own account of herself and is attributed to her.

identity.realm: The seventeenth gate, and the wall above it belongs to the population rather than to his practice: a vaultborn's charge comes from the resonance of the single object it is sealed inside, and one resonator can pressurise one flank vessel or the other and never both, so the first gate needing two flank vessels held at once is unreachable for every vaultborn in the record for the same structural reason. The gates below it, the reservoirs and the heels, are held without difficulty.

appearance.presentation: A population that is not descended and not born, standing on a surface and taking its shape from it, arranged along an inner wall rather than along a floor, and described by everyone who has looked at him differently, because no measurement taken inside the seal has ever been consistent with a second one.
appearance.age: A lifespan measured in the object's cycles rather than in seasons, which makes him older than anyone in the register household that raised him and younger than the wall he is standing on by an accounting nobody has ever been able to close.
appearance.build: Long and shallow, pressed close to whatever he is on, with a flattened chest and hands shaped by the resonance of the stone rather than by grip, which the household reads as a convenience and the register reads as a feature.
appearance.complexion: Grey and faintly luminous along the seams where the wall shows through, and dry everywhere else, because nothing inside the seal has ever been wet and nothing has ever needed it to be.
appearance.hair: None, and a household that has known him for a long time has stopped finding this strange. He keeps a strip of cloth folded over the seam where the wall meets his shoulder, which he changes when it has worn and never when it is asked for.
appearance.eyes: Wide and without a visible focus point, because he navigates by the sounds the object makes and reads them as positions. Two household children have taught themselves to stand where he is not looking when they want to be found.
appearance.palette: Cold stone, wet-iron grey and one living warm value kept low at the throat and along the seams. He is drawn as the same value as the wall he stands on for most of his length in every shot, because in the seal he very nearly is.
appearance.attire: Register-household work-cloth, altered so often it has no original cut, with the seams of the seal worn through at the shoulder and mended with a stitch that is not the household's.
appearance.marks: A seam of living stone along the left shoulder where the wall shows through, the mended stitch over it, and a band of pale deposit at both wrists in the register's own colour.
appearance.bearing: Pressed close to the nearest surface with his head tilted, listening to the object rather than looking at anybody, and startling visibly when a hand is placed on the wall beside him.

canon.role_in_story: The seal's longest-resident reader and the register household's standing evidence that a failed ascent inside the crypt leaves a readable scar. A great ascension injures the ground as well as the body, the reading is published, and the reading names exactly who has nowhere to go, so the household that raises what is left has to be able to read the seal. He is the one who can, and he has spent more of a lifespan than anyone in that household on a single conclusion about the object he is standing on, and that conclusion cannot be written down anywhere except inside the object, which means it cannot be checked, cannot be inherited, and cannot be carried out of the seal by anyone who is not him.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at the crypt wall with his ear against the stone and one hand flat on a seam the household had stopped treating as a scar, answering a register clerk's question about a death inside by naming a moment in the seal's own cycle rather than a year, and then declining, when asked to write it down, to say what the year would have been.
canon.lore: He is not a population that was born. A vaultborn was sealed inside an authored object and has been answering that object's resonance ever since, taking its charge from the object rather than from anything it eats, arranging itself along the object's inner surfaces and taking its shape from whatever it stands on. It hears the object: every sound the object makes is legible as a position, and it navigates by sound rather than by light. Its soul is not held in a body at all. It is seated along the resonance path and therefore distributed through the object, so reading one is reading part of the object, and that single fact reorganises everything an institution does with a person like him. The mind path is open to his species and, by the record, exceptional, because a lifespan measured in the object's cycles is a very long time to learn anything at all, and the household that took him in has spent that time badly on purpose: it teaches him early that a scar in the ground is a published reading, and a published reading names who has nowhere to go. He has read the seal for four figures of years. What he has established is that the object is not inert, that its cycles are not the cycles the register infers, and that several of the deaths inside it were not the deaths the household's own record says. He has established all three without ever once repeating a question, because the only way to get a second reading of this object is to ask it again and asking it again changes what it is reading. That is the whole of his problem and it is not a temperament. The gate he is working toward is the one the mind path reaches before the body path does, and its whole content is that the self is separated from a specific attachment rather than from a limb. Every other practitioner on that gate is dividing themselves from a thing they love. His attachment is the room. His self is not stored anywhere a separation could take it from, because the self is the room's resonance read at one point rather than another, and there is no position inside this object from which his self would be recognisable as his own and separate. So the discipline would have him do precisely the thing that ends him, and the seal would not register the difference: a self released from the resonance and a resonance gone quiet are the same event seen from outside the room, and there is nobody outside the room. The pair is authored on both sides and neither half has been softened. The advantage is the species' own construction: a lifespan in the object's cycles is a longer continuous attention than any body in the setting has ever held, and he is the only copy of everything he has concluded, because the conclusion was written into the object's resonance and it does not exist anywhere else. The cost is the same sentence read the other way. There is no version of his species that survives being carried out of the seal, no technique, no item and no realm that changes it, so the archive is the archive's container and the container cannot be opened without ending the archive and the reader. His household knows this and has never once asked him to leave, and the reason it never asks is that the question would have only one answer and the asking would be a cruelty rather than an inquiry.
history: Came to the register household as debris in the sense the household means it, after a failed ascent inside the crypt scarred the ground and named a body that did not answer, and was raised on the understanding that what was left could read.
Read his first scar inside a season of arriving and reported the moment in the object's cycle, not the year, and has given his readings in the seal's own units ever since.
Refused, at the age most household children can read a whole cycle, to put one question to the object twice, and has never broken that, and the household has stopped asking him to.
Established that several deaths inside the seal did not match the household's own record, and kept the discrepancy in his head rather than in the register, because the register is read outside.

Began the gate that divides a self from a specific attachment, having worked out that his attachment is the room, and has since described it in one sentence to a register clerk who wrote it down and has since been asked to destroy the copy.

Severing is a mind gate before it is a body one: the self is separated from a specific attachment rather than from a limb. His attachment is the room, and there is no position inside this object from which his self would read as separate.

Mind Dao's oldest problem, and the realm where it stops being answerable by practice — which for him stopped being answerable several cycles before he was born into the household.

Children raised by the register household after a failed ascent, because the debris from an opened body is the household's responsibility and the households of the dead are not there to ask. He is the one they raised who could read, and they have never once asked him to leave.
A deep inland, high, authored containment with no wilderness population and never any. It is the only address any of them has, and the only place a reading of this kind can be taken at all.

It may name a seat and may not take one, and it observes from the layer where the surplus imprints are actually written. Its whole content is three states kept apart: does not exist, exists and vacant, refused. A reader whose conclusion lives inside a sealed object and who cannot be carried out to be asked is a person whose state that office could never certify.

reference_stats.combat_read: He should not be fought and there is no version of the fight worth having: the species record gives him half a working frame's worth of physical output and takes half his movement away, and everything it gives him is attention inside one room. What works against him is architectural rather than personal. Put a second body in the seal and he cannot use the seal as an instrument, because the seal is only legible when it is not being performed at. Speak loudly enough and he loses the object's own sound. Threaten the household rather than him and you have found the thing he cannot refuse, because he is the only reader they raised and they have never once asked him to leave, which means they also have never once tested whether he would.

Both halves are the species record's own construction; no mechanical rule has been invented here to make the pairing work.

identity.realm: The eleventh gate, and the obstruction above it belongs to the subspecies: the brine sac runs dorsal to the spine and the penetrating vessel cannot be rejoined across it, so a deepsalt clears the vessels above and below it one at a time and stalls on the one that must close with the others. His sac is larger than the parent saltfolk's, which makes the obstruction larger rather than different, and the subspecies has never been brought to the reservoirs to find out whether the two differences cancel.

appearance.presentation: The floor's assay reader: a salt-dark figure in a dermal crust, built to stand still in the saturated basin floor where nothing above it can stand for long, and to hold a set of scales level for the whole of a weighing without appearing to think about it. The crust on him has been read so often that he reads as a surface rather than as a person.
appearance.age: Older than the assay floor's own record of him, which is the only confident thing anybody on the floor will say about his age. A deepsalt's tissue turns over slowly and an infant is brittle until the second year, so nothing about him dates quickly from the outside.
appearance.build: Low and broad, heavy through the pelvis and the lower back where the sac sits, with a slower and heavier way of rising than anyone above the line ever sees.
appearance.complexion: Grey-crusted and dry, the crust thickening visibly along the forearms and throat, with the salt-scale at the wrists left permanently damp from the floor he stands in.
appearance.hair: None on the crown, with a close fringe of stiffened deposit at the back of the skull gathered and re-cut by hand when it grows into the ear, which he does with a knife and without help.
appearance.eyes: Wide and pale-lidded for the dust, and they do not focus on a face so much as on whatever is in the pan in front of it. He has been told this reads as unfriendly and has stopped explaining that he is looking at the ground because the ground is what he is asked about.
appearance.palette: Crust grey, brine green and pan white, with the single warm value kept very low in a cracked lamp at the weighing desk. He is drawn in the same three values as the pan he works on in every shot, because on the floor he very nearly is the floor's colour.
appearance.attire: Curled hide work-cloth with every seam double-stitched for the drip, a wrap over the lower face against the crust, and a short apron marked in the floor's own chalk, which is the only mark on him that is not salt.
appearance.marks: A hardened crust ridge across the knuckles of both hands where stone has been handled for too many seasons, and the floor's chalk tally band on the apron, which is the only record of his own output that exists anywhere.
appearance.bearing: Very still, head slightly down, weight even on both feet with the soles never raised off the pan, and it is not composure — he cannot raise one foot without the crust on the other beginning to open.

canon.role_in_story: The assay floor's only honest instrument and the standing reason its published figures are believed. A deepsalt reads concentration and cannot tell two salts apart, so the one thing he is constitutionally unable to do is the one thing every buyer on that floor is actually buying, and the standing weight's own rule — weigh, never quote, and let nobody make the first offer — is a rule that was written for a reader exactly like him and that he can satisfy for four hours a day and fail at every other moment of his life. He has been weighed himself into standing by an office that publishes measured stone before any sale precisely so that nobody has to be told the reason, and he is the reason, and the explanation for why the densest bodies in the setting stop one gate short of their own tier is restricted knowledge he is paid to stop being asked about.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at a weighing desk on the hollow measure holding a stone level in both hands while a buyer named a salt aloud, and when the buyer finished, saying that the figure was right and the name did not matter yet and would not matter until the stone was cut, which was the first time anybody had heard him say a whole sentence in front of a buyer.
canon.lore: Everything about him is the parent saltfolk plan with the tolerance turned up and the mobility turned down, and that turns out to describe his working life exactly. A saltfolk's brine sac runs dorsal to the sternum the length of the spine and splits the penetrating vessel into two halves that cannot be rejoined, which is the wall at the eleventh for the whole species. A deepsalt carries a deeper, more capacious sac and a denser dermal crust and slower tissue turnover, so the obstruction is larger rather than different, and the subspecies has never been brought to the reservoirs to find out whether the two differences cancel, because there are too few of them and nobody has spent the water. His mind path is open to him and open narrowly, riding the same salt-head limitation that everything else about his senses rides. That limitation has a plain shape. A saltfolk reads brine concentration across four orders of dilution; a deepsalt's usable range is narrower still and it reads concentration rather than identity, and cannot tell two salts apart. So his judgement is unimprovable about how much of anything is present and does not exist at all about what is present. On a weighing desk that is not a defect. It is the whole of a professional reputation, and the standing weight's own rule says so: weigh, never quote, and let nobody make the first offer, because a buyer who names a figure first forfeits standing, and a common line's entire commercial claim is that it can be assessed without being named in advance. He can assess. He cannot name. The floor publishes measured stone before any sale precisely so that nobody has to be told the reason the stone is worth what it is worth, and the density ceiling's restricted explanation is the other half of that arrangement: everyone with a working face profits from that hole staying a hole. He is the instrument both arrangements depend on and he has no way to audit his own output, because a figure is a quantity and the discipline that eventually pays in a fragment of the reading rather than in the reading's charge takes that fragment inside a window that closes, and a fragment with nothing to identify it is only ever going to be a larger number with no subject. So the same limitation that makes him unimprovable at his job is what makes his job unauditable, and the floor has never resolved that, because resolving it would mean either naming the stone, which nobody wants, or admitting that the floor's figures are weights rather than answers. His ground makes the problem sharper rather than softer. The plains are impossible to survey because spatial law is unspent there, so distance is not conserved and no two surveys of the same ground have ever agreed; a border nobody can measure is a border somebody keeps taking, and every claim on the plains is settled by leaving a marker standing rather than by counting how far away it is. He is the person who leaves the markers. So his own record is a row of weighed figures on a surface that does not hold still, and there is no arithmetic that reconciles them, and the only tool he owns to tell a drift from an error resolves how much moved and not which thing moved. He has been asked three times in his life to name a stone and has answered the question each time, and he has never once pretended the answer was better than the silence that preceded it.
history: Brought down to the saturated floor as a child because the margin is survivable and the floor is where the scales are, and left there, because above the line he does not become ill, he simply stops, and the margin was never going to keep him.
Set a scale level and held it for the length of a first weighing and was not corrected, which is the whole of his entry into the floor's trade and the only qualification he was ever given.

Answered a buyer who named a salt aloud by saying the figure was right and the name would not matter until the stone was cut, which is the first recorded instance of him speaking a whole sentence in front of a buyer.
Refused a restricted explanation on the record when asked for it publicly, and was paid a stipend afterwards, and has treated the stipend as the answer to the question rather than as a bribe for it.

Went back and re-read three years of his own markers on the hollow measure and found they did not reconcile, and put them back exactly where they were rather than re-cutting the measure, which the register records as the only unforced act in his file.

personality.summary: Unimprovable about quantity, entirely incurious about identity, and deeply suspicious of anyone who praises him for the first of those without mentioning the second. He is slow, courteous, and the most patient man on a floor where patience is a professional qualification rather than a virtue.
traits: answers a question about how much before answering a question about what, and answers both in the same tone
refuses to name a composition and never pretends the refusal is modesty, because it is not
will hold a figure for as long as the stone takes and will not release it early for anybody standing there
treats every marker he leaves as provisional and re-reads his own old work without expecting it to hold
accepts a stipend for a refusal out loud and in front of the person who refused him
mannerisms: keeps both soles flat on the pan while he weighs, because lifting one starts the crust opening on the other
turns his head to the ground when addressed, which is not rudeness and which he has given up explaining
takes the lamp with the same hand he takes stone with, so the light is always on the far side of what he is reading
re-ties the mask over his lower face before answering a question he expects to be about a name
goes completely still when a buyer states a salt aloud, and stays still for a beat after
motivations: wants the floor to publish that its figures are weights and not identities, because the not-saying is doing his work and he is not going to be the one who says it by accident
wants to be asked what he cannot do as often as he is asked what he can
wants his markers reconciled against something that is not his own arithmetic
wants the stipends named as refusals in the floor's own book rather than paid out of it
wants to know which salt was in the last stone he weighed, and has decided he would rather be told than find out
flaws: has made professional silence into a virtue and cannot say whether it is one any more
leaves his markers on ground that does not hold still and re-reads them anyway, which is diligence applied to a surface that will not support it
has never named a stone, and has never explained publicly what his naming would cost, which leaves the cost invisible to everybody who buys from the floor
accepts money for a refusal, which is exactly the arrangement he objects to at every other office in the setting
cannot be audited and has not once insisted on being, which is the one thing that would improve his position
personality.voice: Slow, flat, and precise to the point of being boring, with a habit of answering the quantity first and then stopping, deliberately, before the name. He is not taciturn and will discuss crust, drip rates and load figures at length. To a buyer he sounds like an obstacle; to an apprentice he sounds like the only person on the floor who will tell them the truth and then explain why it does not help.
taboos: will not name a composition, for anybody, at any price, on a working floor
will not release a figure before the stone has stopped moving
will not give the density ceiling's explanation in public
will not re-cut a measure or move a marker he has already left standing
will not agree to be carried above the brine line, on the grounds that the agreement would be meaningless and the carrying would be the whole of it

relationships.note: Saltfolk pushed onto the saturated floor until the brine stopped being a habitat and became a requirement, with a deeper sac, a denser crust and slower tissue turnover, and senses with so narrow a usable range that they read concentration rather than identity and cannot tell two salts apart.

Weigh, never quote, and let nobody make the first offer, because a buyer who names a figure first forfeits standing, and a common line's whole commercial claim is that it can be assessed without being named in advance. He satisfies four hours of that and fails at every moment that is not a weighing.

The self held carries a fragment of the reading rather than the reading's charge, and fruit is perishable, so the gate is paid inside a window. A fragment with no identity in it is only ever a larger number with nothing attached to it, which is precisely what his own sense of the world produces.

Spatial law is unspent on the plains, so distance is not conserved and no two surveys of the same ground have ever agreed, and every claim there is settled by leaving a marker standing rather than by counting how far away it is. He leaves the markers, which is why his own record is a row of figures on a surface that will not hold still.

Why the densest bodies in the setting stop one gate short of their own tier. Every holder of a working face profits from that hole staying a hole, and the assay floor publishes measured stone before any sale precisely so that nobody has to be told the reason. He is the measured stone.

The salt-tolerant mat that skins the basin's brine and crusts the pan surface, and the setting's only food base a brine-bearing body can use. He works standing in it, cannot use the pan organisms his parent eats, and could not tell two of them apart if he tried.

reference_stats.summary: A mind-path practitioner of a species that reads concentration rather than identity, holding the assay floor's entire commercial claim on four orders of dilution and on nothing else at all, and standing at the one place in the setting where a figure with no subject is more useful than one with.
strengths: resolves brine concentration across four orders of dilution better than anything else alive, which means no seller on the floor can put an overstated figure past him and no buyer can flatter one into a sale
holds a figure for the whole of a weighing without drift and will not release it early for anybody standing there, so the floor's published numbers are the same numbers every time
is the only body in the setting that can prove how much of a thing is present and cannot be fooled by a composition being dressed up, because a dressed-up salt is still a quantity
reads at the speed of the crust on the pan rather than the speed of a claim, so an overstated stone simply takes longer
is unmovable in the one direction that matters, which is the reason he cannot be replaced by anybody cleverer sent up from the margin
weaknesses: cannot tell two salts apart at all, so his judgement is absent rather than weak on the one question every buyer on that floor is actually asking
stands at the saturated floor because above the brine line he does not become ill, he stops, which makes him the most immobile valuable instrument in the setting
cannot audit his own output, because a fragment of a reading with nothing to identify it is only ever a larger number, and his figure is only ever a number
leaves markers on ground where distance is not conserved and no two surveys have ever agreed, so his own three years of output do not reconcile and he re-reads them anyway
takes money for refusing a question, which is the same arrangement he objects to at every other office and which he has never once tried to stop taking
reference_stats.combat_read: He should not be fought and there is very little point in trying. Everything his species gives is supply and nothing it gives is offence: the crust, the sac, the slowness, the floor he cannot leave. What defeats him is the same thing that defeats a scale. Separate him from the pan and he is finished within hours, so the whole of his protection is that nobody wants him anywhere else, and the pressure that actually works on him is social and commercial: make a buyer name the salt in front of a crowd and he is a man refusing to work rather than a man doing the only thing he can do, and his authority is built entirely on the distinction between those two things. Make him move and you have removed his value and his life in the same gesture. He has never been in a fight and describes the possibility as a bookkeeping problem.
notes: The advantage and its cost are one authored sense read two ways and are not separated here: the deepsalt reads concentration rather than identity, which makes the judgement unimprovable about quantity and absent about what is present. Both halves are the subspecies record's own construction; no mechanical rule has been invented here to make the pairing work.

The deepsalt record states an eleventh ceiling with a mechanism, and that mechanism is a structural claim about the brine sac. The mind path's own narrowness is quoted from the subspecies record as 'open, and narrowly, with the same salt-head limitation' and has not been given a rung.
Nothing in the bible states what an assay reader can or cannot certify, so the commercial arrangement on that floor is written as his account of it and is attributed to him.

The gate named for him is quoted from the record as one that pays inside a window in a fragment of the reading rather than in the reading's charge. The fragment's unusability without an identity is his own reasoning and is described as such.

name: Odalinde Krast
aliases: the first name in a queue she cannot survive

identity.realm: The eleventh gate, and the wall at the eleventh is the saltfolk's rather than hers: the brine sac runs dorsal to the sternum the length of the spine and splits the penetrating vessel into two halves that cannot be rejoined, so the vessels above and below it are cleared one at a time and the practice stalls on the one that has to close with the others. Above that wall her path is not shut and has no ceiling in her either; it is that her mind path dulls as she leaves the brine, which the saltfolk record states as a limitation on the path rather than as a wall on the ladder.

appearance.presentation: The only candidate on a pan margin that the Terrace Council has ever put forward, and the reason she is readable at all is the salt crust that builds visibly along the jaw and forearms of anyone who has spent a season working standing water. It is the one feature of her appearance that any pan household can verify at a glance and that a court above the line has no way to check.
appearance.age: Old for a saltfolk and unremarkable for it, since the salt-dense frame and the crust together make a body look slower than it is. The estimate her household signed is the only document about her age that anybody has ever produced.
appearance.build: Broad through the chest and the hips, heavy-footed and long-ribbed, with a splay to the feet that is the pan plan and not a deformity, and the frame of somebody who has carried water for forty years.
appearance.complexion: Dry and salt-pale, the crust thickening along the jaw and the forearms in visible plates that are re-crusted rather than washed, and damp only at the wrists and the throat.
appearance.hair: Bleached pale by the crust and cut blunt at the jaw for the sun, with a working braid kept in a length of woven cord that she has replaced so often it has no original length left.
appearance.eyes: Wide and dark in a pale face, and they stay open longer than is comfortable, because the species reads the world by taste and a long unbroken look at the pan is how the taste arrives. She has been told it is unnerving and has decided that is the wrong problem to solve.
appearance.palette: Crust white, pan grey and brine green, with the one saturated warm value kept low at the throat where the brine line sits, and nothing else in the picture is allowed to be warm. Her court papers are drawn as the only pale flat object in any frame that contains her, and they are the wrong colour for the ground she is standing on.
appearance.attire: Crust-curl hide work-cloth with double-stitched seams, a broad brim re-crusted rather than cleaned, and a pan-house under-robe worn expressly under the court coat she has had made for a sitting she has not yet been granted.
appearance.marks: Salt plate along the jaw and both forearms, a hard callus line at the base of each thumb from pan work, and a thin healed split at the left wrist from a downpour three seasons back, which she wears openly and does not explain.
appearance.bearing: Steady and unhurried, walking with the deliberate economy of somebody who is counting the distance to water, and standing with her feet apart and her head slightly down when there is a court present.

canon.role_in_story: The Terrace Council's first candidate from the salt line, and the reason a court that cannot be a candidate for any of its own terraces now has one. Nothing on the third layer grows, recovers, adapts or is cheap, nine surplus imprints have nowhere to go but up, and access there is a discipline rather than a journey, so the tier's whole hierarchy is a queue with no slack in it: a place given wrongly is not corrected later, it is simply lost. The Council sits in odd numbers, may seat and unseat and refuse, and grants no power at all — recognition is projected as a bounded percent on an allowlist, never a flat and never a base write — so its entire economic product is access. She is the strongest candidate on that queue by a long way, and the strongest thing about her only works on the pan, and the third layer is dry.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at a pan margin being weighed against two other candidates by a court clerk who had been told to look at her jaw, and who said, in front of everybody, that her crust could not be faked and that the rest of her could not be checked at all, and then asked her whether she understood what the second half meant.
canon.lore: The basin is a closed evaporite system on the dry margin of the plains, and the mortal world spends three of its six law slots on physical, life and qi and writes no spatial law at all, which means the basin cannot drain, move or be surveyed out of and the brine line is a border nobody had to agree to. That is the ground she is the best reader of in the setting and the worst candidate for leaving. A saltfolk reads brine concentration across four orders of dilution, which no other body in the record approaches; a human nose finds a saltfolk sour. That gift is why a pan household has never once been able to overstate a figure to her, and it is the whole basis of a reputation that has carried her name to a conclave she has never been inside. Her cost is written in the same species record, immediately and in plain words: salt head dulls fine discrimination in dry air. The mind path is open to her, and it is open on the condition that took her finest sense with it the moment she left the pan. So the discipline she is qualified for and the tier that would reward the qualification are, for her specifically, in opposite directions, and neither the Council nor the holding assembly has a mechanism for that problem because neither of them has ever had a candidate who sharpened as she dried. There is a second cost, which is anatomical and older: the brine sac runs dorsal to the sternum the length of the spine and splits the penetrating vessel into two halves that cannot be rejoined, so the vessels above and below it are cleared one at a time and the practice stalls on the one that must close with the others. Everything above that rung on her ladder is a thing she has heard about. The third cost is the one that decides her life. She cannot drink fresh water and fails above the brine line within about nine days, and rain is a hazard rather than a blessing, because a saltfolk caught in a downpour is functionally drowning — which is why the species is the least mobile people in the setting and why a household that keeps no stores times its year against somebody else's livestock. She needs standing brine within a day of travel. And the third layer is a tier where nothing grows, nothing recovers, nothing adapts and nothing is cheap, whose ecology is a ranking rather than a web, and whose entire hierarchy is the surplus itself: fifteen imprints over three layers leave nine duplicate imprints as the ground, so standing in surplus is the rank. A place there given wrongly is not corrected later. It is simply lost, which is why the queue is one ordering and two bodies placing names produce an ordering nobody may obey. So the most qualified candidate for a terrace is the candidate who cannot survive on it, the finest instrument on the pan is the instrument that dulls the moment the ladder asks her to carry it upward, and the one name that could be moved to the front of the queue is the name that cannot be there at all. She has read her own position correctly and has not made a single move to fix it, because every fix she can see requires either the brine or the body, and she has one of those and cannot have the other.
history: Worked the pan margin from childhood on a household that kept no stores and timed its year against somebody else's herd, which is why she has never once planned further than a season in her life and is now planning for a tier.

Caught a downpour three seasons back and was found at the margin by two households, which is the injury she wears openly and does not explain, and which is the first time the species' second weakness ever became personal to her.

Read a disputed brine figure for the pan's own court at nineteen, settled it on quantity, and was told by the losing party that a body which cannot name a salt should not be asked to settle a salt, and has kept the sentence.

Put forward for a terrace by a Council clerk who had been sent to find somebody the plains had not tried, and was told in front of the whole queue that her crust could not be faked and that the rest of her could not be checked at all.

Refused, in writing, to withdraw her name from the queue on the grounds that withdrawing would leave the position empty and an empty position is read as one that does not exist, which is a three-state rule she had to be taught by the clerk who nominated her.

personality.summary: Reads a room the way she reads the pan — by long exposure and by what it tastes of — and has the specific frustration of a person whose greatest competence is local and whose whole argument is that the local part is the transferable part. She is warm, direct, and much harder to argue with than anybody who has not had to be right about water in public.
traits: answers any question about a place by telling you what it would taste of, and treats that as a real answer rather than as a mannerism
names the cost of leaving the pan before she names the case for it, in that order, every time
counts the distance to standing brine as a routine part of any plan she makes, including plans she never intends to execute
will not withdraw a name from a queue because an empty position is read as a position that does not exist
treats being doubted on the margin as evidence and being doubted at the court as a scheduling problem
mannerisms: stands with her feet apart and her head slightly down when a court is present
takes a long unbroken look at the ground before answering anything about a place
tastes the air once, deliberately, when somebody describes a location to her
keeps one hand on the brim of her hat whenever she is indoors, because the brim is worth more than the room's opinion of her
says a street's name in the register of the pan it replaced, which is a small rudeness she has never been told to stop
motivations: wants the Council to name a tier she can reach rather than a tier she can be certified for, and has not yet found out whether that is a request or a slur
wants the salt-head limitation written into the queue's own terms so that the next salt-line candidate is not sent up to arrive useless
wants to be believed about quantity on a floor where every court above the line is looking at her jaw
wants the holding assembly to explain why its own floor cannot hold a saltfolk, in writing, so that the answer exists
wants to be asked whether she would go, before anyone arranges for her to
flaws: has made staying the loyal choice and can no longer say whether it is loyalty or prudence
counts distance to brine so constantly that she has stopped being able to imagine a place without one
tastes the air as an answer, which is exact and is not what anybody at a court is asking her
refused to withdraw, and the refusal has left a position in the queue that cannot be filled and cannot be vacated, and she knows that
has never once asked the Council whether they would seat somebody who could not stay, because she has assumed the answer and built four years of refusal on it
personality.voice: Warm, quick, and concrete to the point of being abrupt, with a habit of grounding any abstract question in a specific stretch of ground within a day's walk of standing brine. She is funnier than she sounds and gets quieter rather than louder when she is afraid. To a court she sounds evasive and is being precise; to a pan household she sounds like weather.
taboos: will not drink fresh water, on the pan or anywhere else, whatever is offered
will not be carried above the brine line, whatever the reason and whoever asks
will not name a salt she cannot taste, in public, for any price
will not withdraw her own name from a queue
will not let a court check her crust instead of checking her

relationships.note: Built for brine no softer body could drink, with taste that reads concentration across four orders of dilution and salt head that dulls fine discrimination in dry air, a sac that splits the penetrating vessel, and a total dependence on a standing supply within a day's travel. Everything she is and everything she cannot survive is in that one record.

Nothing on the third layer grows, recovers, adapts or is cheap, nine surplus imprints have nowhere to go but up, and access is a discipline rather than a journey. A queue is a single ordering, and a place given wrongly on that tier is not corrected later — it is lost.

Nothing there grows, recovers, adapts or is cheap, and the only thing that happens is law being written nine more times, so the duplicate imprints are the ground and standing in surplus is the rank. There is no brine on it and nothing that would put one there.

It decides who may step onto nine engraved terraces and cannot be a candidate for any of them, seats and unseats and refuses, and grants no power at all — recognition is a bounded percent on an allowlist, so its entire product is access. She is the name it put forward, and it cannot be judged on the question and so cannot be asked it.

A mortal frame writes no spatial law, so the basin cannot drain or be surveyed out of and the brine line is the only boundary it has. She reads it across four orders of dilution, and it is the one edge in the setting that will move for her if she takes four steps.

Every appointment in both polities passes a trial the naming office cannot judge, because the highest office may name a seat and may not take one. Her trial would be run by a body that cannot rule on the only question her body raises, which is whether she can stay.

reference_stats.summary: A mind-path practitioner whose species' finest sense and whose species' hard limit are the same fact read from opposite ends, holding the front of a queue with no slack on a tier that has no brine on it, and priced by a court that can verify her crust and nothing else about her.
strengths: reads brine concentration across four orders of dilution, which no other body in the setting approaches and which makes it impossible to flatter or overstate a figure to her on her own ground
can settle a disputed quantity for a pan court by measurement alone, and has never lost one, because the dispute has always been about how much
has a crust that builds visibly along the jaw and forearms, so any household on the line can verify her seasoning at a glance and no court above the line has any way to check it
is the least mobile person in the setting and therefore the hardest to displace from a queue, which has kept her name in it through four refusals
knows the price of leaving the pan precisely enough to name it before anyone else does
weaknesses: loses the fine end of her own discrimination the moment she leaves the brine, so the one tier that would reward her qualification is the tier that takes the qualification away
fails above the brine line within about nine days and cannot drink fresh water, and rain is a hazard rather than a blessing, so there is no version of a long posting that she survives
stalls at the eleventh gate on a split penetrating vessel, so everything above that rung on her ladder is a thing she has heard about
is the front name in a queue with no slack, on a tier where nothing recovers, so the position she holds is the position she cannot occupy
is certified by a court that grants access and no power at all, so the entire return on her life is a door she would have to be alive to stand behind
reference_stats.combat_read: She should not be fought, and the species gives her almost nothing that would decide one: a salt-dense frame that resists what would break an ordinary body, and no offence to speak of. What she has instead is a judgement that cannot be lied to on her own ground, which makes her extremely hard to cheat and completely useless in a room with no water in it. The pressure that works on her is therefore procedural and it is the only kind available: put her in a dry hall for long enough and the sense she is famous for simply stops resolving, and everyone present can see it happening, and there is nothing she can do about it in real time. Against a queue, the effective attack is a scheduling error — a place given wrongly on a tier where nothing recovers is not a delay, it is a loss, and she has put herself in the exact position where one mistake costs her the whole argument.
notes: The advantage and its cost are one authored line read twice and are not separated here: the saltfolk read brine concentration across four orders of dilution and salt head dulls fine discrimination in dry air. Both halves are the species record's own construction, and no mechanical rule has been invented here to make the pairing work.

The saltfolk record states an eleventh ceiling with a mechanism, and that mechanism is a structural claim about the brine sac splitting the penetrating vessel. The dulling of the mind path in dry air is quoted from the same record as a limitation on the path, not as a rung, and the two are kept apart deliberately.

Nothing in the bible states how a court handles a candidate who cannot remain at the tier it is nominating, so the three-state seat vocabulary and the vacancy rules are quoted rather than extended, and the arrangement on that tier is described from her side.

The queue, the surplus and the tier's lack of slack are all quoted from the conflict and ecology records as authored. What is hers is the counting, which is written as a habit and not as a rule with a value.
